in_hebrew.name: בייסלי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word באסלאא (Beasla'a), meaning 'handsome, beautiful' or 'God is beautiful'. This name is not directly found in the Bible but is derived from the biblical name Bezalel (ביזלאל), which means 'in the shadow of God'.

in_greek.name: Βεασλει
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek form of the Hebrew name Bezalel, which means 'in the shadow of God'. The name Beasley is not directly found in the Bible in Greek but is derived from the biblical name.

in_latin.name: Beasleius
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin form of the Greek name Beaslei, which is derived from the biblical name Bezalel (Βεζαλελ), meaning 'in the shadow of God'.
